thought.text: Node 24.9.0 installed. Now let me set up Yarn 4.13.0 via corepack.

reasoning_content: Node 24.9.0 has been installed. Next, install Yarn 4.13.0 via corepack (Node 24 comes bundled with corepack). corepack enable + corepack prepare yarn@4.13.0 --activate. Note: corepack may require a download from the yarn repository (repo.yarnpkg.com). Let's give it a try.

action.command: corepack enable 2>&1; COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 corepack prepare yarn@4.13.0 --activate 2>&1; export PATH="/opt/tools/node-v24.9.0/bin:$PATH"; yarn --version
